name: Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB)
description: MTEB is a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating text embeddings across 8 tasks, 58 datasets, and 112 languages. It enables assessment of embedding models on diverse applications such as semantic textual similarity, clustering, and reranking, providing a unified evaluation framework and public leaderboard.
reputation: Most comprehensive text embedding benchmark to date, widely used for embedding model evaluation.
notes: Includes 33 models benchmarked; no single embedding method dominates all tasks; open-source code and leaderboard available.
